northstar.ponder.combustion_engine.heade: Generating Rotational Force using Combustion Engines
northstar.ponder.combustion_engine.text_: Combustion Engines burn fuel to produce kinetic force
Fuel must be inserted on the side opposite of the shaft
And the engine will start automatically
The rotation speed and stress capacity depend on the fuel being used
The engine also requires oxidizer which can be obtained from one of 3 sources
The simplest is the atmosphere, this will work on Earth and other planets with a breathable atmosphere
Alternatively an artificial atmosphere can be created with an Oxygen Sealer
Or Oxidizer can be inserted from below the engine.
northstar.ponder.oxygen_filler.text_1: The Oxygen Filler can be used to fill or empty spacesuits
northstar.ponder.oxygen_filler.text_2: Items can be inserted or removed by right-clicking
northstar.ponder.oxygen_filler.text_3: Oxygen Gas is required to fill spacesuits
northstar.ponder.oxygen_filler.text_4: It can then be pumped into the spacesuit
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_1: The rocket needs thruster(s) to be able to fly, the amount required is dependent on the size and weight of the rocket.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_2: The thrusters require fuel, you need one or more tanks containing Hydrocarbon, Hydrogen or Methane.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_3: And optionally some additional storage for equipment and resources.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_4: Rockets also need at least one seat to sit on during the flight.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_5: The rocket station allows to choose the destination and assemble the rocket. It also displays information about the fuel and heat shielding needed to travel across planets.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_6: Rocket controls allow to launch and control the rocket once assembled.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_7: An interplanetary navigator is required to travel to other planets, this doesn't apply to moons.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_8: Heat Shielding can be increased by adding metallic blocks.
northstar.ponder.rocket.text_9: Don't forget to glue it. You can use scaffolding or individual glue sections.
